name: com.ruyuejian/ruyuejian-jobs-mcp
title: Ruyuejian Jobs
description: Search China tech jobs from official career pages with source URLs and daily refresh.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search active China job postings collected from company official career pages. Use a short job-title keyword, a Chinese city name, optional company and recruitment type. postedWithinDays is a rolling N*24-hour filter over at most 100 scanned records. Every job includes provenance when available. NO_RESULTS and partial date coverage must be reported honestly; never invent jobs or URLs.

query.description: Short job-title keyword such as "AI 产品经理" or "前端". Do not pass a full sentence.

city.description: City or location name as written by users, for example "北京". Do not convert it to a slug.

company.description: Company name or distinctive substring, for example "腾讯".

recruitmentType.description: Recruitment type: social, campus, or intern.

offset.description: Zero-based upstream page offset. Must be 0 with postedWithinDays.

postedWithinDays.description: Rolling N*24-hour window measured from official publication time, falling back to first-seen time. Scans at most 100 upstream records.

tools.name: get_job_detail
tools.description: Get full details for an exact job UUID returned by search_jobs. A missing or delisted job returns no_results, never a reconstructed posting.

id.description: Exact job UUID returned by search_jobs.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: List companies and active job counts, optionally filtered by short job title, Chinese city and recruitment type. Counts are not postings: call search_jobs to retrieve actual jobs.

query.description: Short job-title keyword such as "AI 产品经理" or "前端". Do not pass a full sentence.

city.description: City or location name as written by users, for example "北京". Do not convert it to a slug.

recruitmentType.description: Recruitment type: social, campus, or intern.

limit.description: Maximum companies to return after aggregation.

tools.name: get_campus_timeline
tools.description: Get the current campus recruiting timeline, per-phase source URLs and confidence values. Missing dates must remain missing; do not infer them.
